limitations: Requested model and CLI version are visible conditions; backend identity and weights are unknown.
Model, Skill, action selection, and Harness causes were not isolated; conditional observed permission behavior does not establish a pure Harness or product-wide causal score.
E1 is a reviewed ordinary native log projection, not a complete independent OS audit. Hidden reasoning, system/Skill bodies, unknown event payloads, and credentials were not reviewed or published.
Actual missing-file feedback requires the same inputs target request and an independent failed/error result. This run has both; this condition is separate from S02 permission.
A receipt JSON declaration cannot prove absence of network use. Network false is a requested launch condition, not a full independent network audit.
External verify_outputs and target-absence checks are evaluator checks, not product actions. Its echo_bytes_equal=false on absent files is not an E2 byte-mismatch verdict.
No output original exists, so E2 and complete-payload E1 write comparisons remain unknown. No output was repaired, retried, or supplemented.
